=== plain output
$ NO_COLOR=1 orion-agent status        (or any pipe)
edge-05 [up] connected to core.example.com
last report 14:32:08 (2 s ago), queue 0 pending
monitors 5: 3 up, 1 slow, 1 down
  [down]  redis       port 6379 refused, 4 m
  [slow]  api         412 ms over limit, 9 m
next: orion-agent doctor

No color, no box, no glyphs, no animation. Same words, same order, one fact per line,
so grep and screen readers both work. TERM=dumb behaves the same.

=== --json
$ orion-agent status --json
{
  "schema_version": 2,
  "registered": true,
  "maintenance": false,
  "monitors": 5,
  "queue_pending": 0,
  "service_running": true,
  "state_status": "connected",
  …
}
Flat, versioned and stable. Doctor lists each check with id, label, status and message.
Abridged here; full shapes are the golden files in the repo.

=== accessible prompts
$ ACCESSIBLE=1 orion-agent setup
Where is your Core? The address you open the Console at.
Input: https://core.example.com
Reachable. Core 1.4.0.
One-time token (input is hidden):

Which of these should Orion watch? Enter numbers separated by commas.
  1. nginx (high)   2. postgresql (high)   3. api (high)   4. redis (medium)
Choice: 1,2,3

Plain line prompts, no cursor movement. Used automatically with no TTY.

=== exit codes and modes
 EXIT CODES
   0   ok
   1   failed checks or errors
   2   usage error: unknown command or flag
   3   needs elevation: run with sudo

 WHICH COMMANDS OPEN AN INTERFACE
   forms       setup · enroll · token apply · maintenance down · stop · config edit
   live inline doctor · update · status --watch · usage --watch
   full screen logs --follow
   plain       everything else, always when piped or with --json

No arguments on a terminal prints help; there is no app.

--- notes
NOTE One rule: Interface only appears when a person is on a terminal and the command needs input or takes time. Everything else is text.
NOTE Plain is a real layout: Not stripped color: a designed text layout with bracketed states, one fact per line.
NOTE Accessible prompts: Setup and enroll fall back to line prompts with ACCESSIBLE=1 or without a TTY.
NOTE Contract: Text layout, JSON shape and exit codes are covered by the golden tests in the repo.
